in_hindi.name: Vijju
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Conqueror
in_hindi.long_meaning: Vijju एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vijju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijay', which means conqueror or victorious. This name is often given to a boy to signify his strength, bravery, and victory in life.
